page.layout: One printed plate (engraving) in the centre of the page, showing the crucifixion with animals below; a library stamp in blue at the lower right; fragments of printed text visible at the extreme left edge (the outer margin of the neighbouring page), not transcribed.
page.notes: Full-page engraving of the Crucifixion with lions and other beasts at the foot of the cross, a landscape with a castle at the left; no printed words within the engraving. A blue library stamp at lower right (ignored as stamp). At the left edge, a strip of fragmentary letters belonging to the neighbouring page (show-through/edge), not transcribed.
